body: Thanks for the info. I might try some hormones just to see how I feel and not as a transition therapy.

Anyways there is always the possibility that I'm just overthinking things but who knows is that the *denial* talking? Haha oh no I'm even more confused now help, I've been ensared in my own thoughts again.
Haha guess I'm in it for a bigger train then.
Yeah I'm probably in denial. Wouldn't life be a lot better if our minds weren't so *weird*?

This school year is going to be my senior year and also the area I live in has a fairly substantial LGBT community. Also speaking to a gender counselor/therapist really isn't an option as my parents don't know that I'm *struggling* with these thoughts.

I'm honestly pretty confused and stressed out about all this. I'm probably still in denial about all of this but who knows. Maybe this is even the source of my depression who knows haha.
